title: Psychic medium explains the voice in the witch encounter as a guardian angel

tellings.quote: "Oh, that was your that was your guardian angel or your higher self or whatever you want to call it talking to you."

plain: A voice that Brent Friedman says he heard during a frightening encounter with what he calls a witch, in a bungalow in Los Angeles, was his guardian angel speaking to him. That is how a psychic medium friend of his, whom he does not name, explained it, and Friedman, who says he lived through the encounter, repeats her words: "that was your guardian angel or your higher self or whatever you want to call it talking to you."
